flavorPatch: The blade finds the frailest neck.
Knowledge costs blood; the ledger balances itself.
Reap what the grave has sown.
A glance that withers steel and flesh alike.
Darkness grips tightest where the light is weakest.
Life flows where the lantern points.
The dead answer every summons.
The plague does not discriminate; it collects.
Even feathers grow heavy when the mire claims them.
The tide takes what the shore forgets.
The abyss rises; the surface drowns.
No anchor holds against the crushing deep.
The current decides who moves.
What the wave brings, the wave takes back.
The undertow respects no allegiance.
Songs of the deep carry maps to buried wealth.
Pressure at depth crushes hulls and armies alike.
The pull is gentle; the return is not.
A toy that always comes back — until it doesn't.
The oil-slick path leads only one way: back.
The counter-spell is a ripple that unravels the cast.
Snag the thread; the tapestry unravels.
The flood recedes; the stranded remain.
Melodies from the deep chart roads to forgotten riches.
The serpent strikes where the water is darkest.
Tides turn; enemies return to sender.
A bolt that splits the sky and the defense.
Two targets, one current — neither escapes.
Iron obeys the hand that forged it.
Scrap remembers the shape it once held.
